leading_positions.synthesis: Five of eight members explicitly prefer B026 (targeted protein degradation), all with the same three laureates (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) and citations that differ only in wording: Aili, Aqvist and Chabes stress a designable chemical reaction or new pharmacological principle, Brzezinski and Linke stress induced proximity as a single mechanism that covers both PROTACs and glues. Shared: the ternary-complex mechanism is quantitative and independently reproduced, and one citation can cover glues and PROTACs. Not shared: how much weight the absence of an approved PROTAC drug should carry (Brzezinski and Linke treat it as the strongest objection; Aili, Aqvist and Chabes treat approved glue drugs as sufficient), and whether Ciulli should displace Deshaies or Handa. Somfai, Sparr and Zou list B026 only as an alternative.

Two members prefer palladium-catalysed C-N coupling with Buchwald and Hartwig. Zou dropped Kosugi from the opening proposal after Somfai's reply, so the two now match on laureates; both want the citation to name carbon-nitrogen coupling explicitly. Shared: clean two-person attribution and mature, independently confirmed adoption. Open: whether it is a distinct achievement or a continuation of the 2010 C-C coupling prize. Both list B026 as an alternative; no other member lists B060 as preferred or alternative.

One member (Sparr) prefers biomolecular condensates with Hyman, Brangwynne and Rosen, as a general physical-chemical principle of intracellular organisation. Aqvist, Chabes, Linke and Brzezinski each state reservations about in vivo evidence and the omission of Pappu and Mittag; Sparr herself concedes these points as the main case against. She lists B026 as her first alternative.

areas_of_agreement: B026 is the preferred configuration of five members and the listed alternative of the other three (Somfai, Sparr, Zou), with identical laureates (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) in all five preferred configurations.
No member argues that the quantitative ternary-complex mechanism is in doubt; the objections to B026 are about clinical maturity, the PROTAC/glue split and the three-person cut.

Members agree B067 (sequencing by synthesis) is a mature chemical invention with large impact; the reservation raised by Linke, Aqvist, Chabes, Somfai, Sparr, Zou and Brzezinski is attribution (Solexa versus 454 pyrosequencing, Mayer, Ju) and field fit, not merit.
Members agree the three-person limit forces omissions in B026 (Ciulli, Gray, Sakamoto, Kim, Ito) and that any omission needs an explicit rationale.
Members agree on B060 that the Buchwald and Hartwig attribution is cleaner than most, and that Kosugi is a precedent rather than the decisive step.
scientific_disputes: Whether B026 is chemistry or pharmacology: Somfai says the core chemistry is linker and ligand design on known E3 ligands, and Linke notes the cereblon story is partly pharmacology; Aili, Aqvist and Chabes read induced-proximity ubiquitination as a new designable chemical reaction.
Whether the PROTAC and molecular-glue arms are one discovery or two: Brzezinski and Sparr raise a split, while Linke, Chabes and Aili argue for a single induced-proximity citation.

Whether in vivo condensates (B031) are true thermodynamic phase separation or other assemblies or overexpression artefacts: Sparr accepts the evidence is uneven, while Aqvist, Chabes, Linke and Aili treat this as decisive against leading with it now.

Whether B028 (Gray and Winkler) is a mechanism-level contribution that changed chemical practice: Brzezinski prefers it on physical clarity, Somfai, Chabes and Aili question its breadth beyond Marcus theory.
Whether base editing (B038) is molecule-making chemistry or protein engineering: Aqvist and Chabes treat the deaminase work as chemistry; Somfai doubts it is molecule-making.
attribution_disputes: B026 third laureate: Handa (with Ito) versus Ciulli. Aqvist, Chabes, Linke and Aili keep Handa; Zou's opening and Aili's response flag Ciulli's VHL ligands and ternary-complex structures as decisive, and Aqvist is willing to hear a case for Ciulli replacing Deshaies. Sakamoto, Kim, Gray and Ito are named by several members as excluded.
B026 anchor: the 2001 PROTAC proof of concept (Crews, Deshaies, Sakamoto, Kim) versus the cereblon mechanism (Handa, Ito) as the basis of the citation wording.
B067: Balasubramanian and Klenerman (Solexa) versus a wider set including Rothberg (454), Mayer and Ju; Somfai asks that any citation be limited to reversible-terminator and cluster chemistry.
B031: Pappu and Mittag would be left out of a Hyman, Brangwynne and Rosen prize although their sticker-and-spacer framework supplies the quantitative content.
B060: Kosugi (tin-amide precedent) was included by Zou in the opening and dropped in round 1; Somfai also excludes him.
B038: Liu alone (Chabes, Somfai) versus Komor and Gaudelli as separate inventors (Aqvist), with Nishida and Kondo (Target-AID) making the credit contestable.
maturity_disputes: No PROTAC drug is approved: Brzezinski (who now prefers B026 after his opening placed it fourth), Linke, Somfai, Sparr, Zou and Aqvist each flag this; Aili, Chabes and Aqvist argue approved lenalidomide-class glues and many independent replications establish the principle. No member has verified current clinical status in this process.
B031 in vivo claims are still debated (Aqvist, Chabes, Linke, Brzezinski) versus Sparr's view that fifteen years of replication makes recognition timely.
B038 follows the 2020 CRISPR prize and has thinner clinical data than other candidates (Aili, Chabes, Aqvist).
B001 (nitrogenase): structure is mature but the mechanism is unsettled (Brzezinski, Zou, Aqvist).
B060 is mature but may read as a continuation of the 2010 cross-coupling prize (Somfai, Sparr, Zou).
conflict_or_recusal_flags: Zou states a broad network in porous materials and electron crystallography that includes some credited people in B046 and B068, and says the member would recuse from any vote depending on that field; this does not affect the B060 preference.
Brzezinski flags B028 and B001 as close to his own bioenergetics field and asks that his views on them be discounted; he is also a Stockholm University colleague of Zou.
Linke (chair) notes a nanophysics and nanopore-adjacent background that could bias him toward B021 and thermodynamic-style arguments; B021 is not preferred by any member.
Sparr notes she is a Lund colleague of Linke and Somfai (institutional only) and that her soft-matter field may bias her toward B031.
Chabes notes subject-matter proximity to the sequencing and base-editing candidates but no tie to credited names; no member discloses a tie to any credited laureate in B026, B060 or B031.
questions_for_round2: Is the absence of an approved heterobifunctional PROTAC drug disqualifying on maturity grounds, or is the principle sufficiently established by ternary-complex mechanism, independent replication and approved cereblon-dependent glues? Members should state which standard they apply.

Should the B026 citation anchor on the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and the cereblon mechanism (Handa) as one induced-proximity principle, and who among Handa, Ciulli, Deshaies, Sakamoto, Kim, Gray and Ito is least defensible to omit under the three-person limit?
Is the B026 achievement chemistry rather than pharmacology or biology, and what would a citation worded in chemical terms say without naming drugs?

If B067 is pursued as the fall-back, can the reports show that the reversible-terminator and cluster chemistry of Balasubramanian and Klenerman is separable from the 454, Mayer and Ju lineages, and does it fit Chemistry rather than Physiology or Medicine?
Does B060 stand as a distinct achievement from the 2010 cross-coupling prize, and would the committee accept the two-person Buchwald and Hartwig citation naming carbon-nitrogen coupling explicitly?
For B031, which in vivo measurements show quantitative liquid-liquid phase separation rather than overexpression artefact, and can a three-person prize omit Pappu and Mittag?
Are members who rank B026 only as an alternative (Somfai, Sparr, Zou) willing to support it in a final configuration, and under what conditions on maturity or attribution?
summary.chair_observation: On the explicit round-1 files, B026 with Crews, Deshaies and Handa is the preferred configuration of five of eight members, which equals the stated majority threshold; B060 has two and B031 has one. All five B026 supporters name the same open issues (clinical maturity, Ciulli, and the glue-versus-PROTAC framing), and two members record a change since the openings (Brzezinski moved B026 up from fourth; Linke now treats B067 as a fall-back rather than the lead). The three members preferring other candidates each list B026 as an alternative. Round 2 should settle these three issues before the group moves to final configurations; this summary is a record of stated positions and not a ruling.
